## Description

Please include a summary of the change, which issue it fixes, and relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / Code quality improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the non-negotiable rules in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
  - [ ] Plain JavaScript only (no TypeScript)
  - [ ] JSDoc comments included
  - [ ] React components use `.jsx`
  - [ ] No Microsoft logos, names, or fonts
  - [ ] Bundled open fonts and Lucide icons only
  - [ ] Offline-first, no external network requests
  - [ ] Small files (< 300 lines)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes with zero errors and zero warnings
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] Conventional Commit message used
